name: Tresorit
summary: End-to-end encrypted cloud storage and secure file sharing. Protect sensitive business documents with zero-knowledge security and granular access controls.
best_for: businesses and professionals with confidentiality obligations (legal, health, finance) that need end-to-end-encrypted storage, granular sharing controls and compliance features
skip_if: you want cheap bulk storage or deep app integrations (mainstream clouds win), or a personal-grade E2EE like Proton Drive covers your needs at lower cost
honest_knock: You pay the Swiss-E2EE premium (noticeably above mainstream clouds and above Proton Drive per GB) and the encryption trade-offs are inherent: no server-side content search, more deliberate sharing flows, and credential/recovery discipline is on you. For regulated teams that's exactly the deal; for casual storage it's over-engineering.

pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-11-05 on tresorit.com/pricing/business, /personal, /tresorit-engage and /file-sharing in a browser, both billing toggles; Tresorit announced a price increase to partners on 5 November 2026) There are three business plans: Professional for 1 user, Business from 3 users and Business Pro from 5 users. Priced from our location in euros, they run €36, €24 and €30 per user per month on monthly billing, and €28.80, €19.20 and €24 on yearly, which the page badges as 20% off. Before the increase we read €29.99, €20 and €25 monthly and €23.99, €16 and €20 yearly (14 August 2026). Personal runs a permanent free Basic tier plus Lite, Essential and Pro: €5.99, €13.99 and €35.99 a month on monthly billing, €4.79, €11.19 and €28.79 a month on yearly billing. Engage, the data-room product, is priced separately: Engage Professional (1 room manager, 5 contributors) €71 a month and Engage Business (at least 3 room managers, 15 contributors) €177 a month on monthly billing, €63.80 and €162.60 on yearly billing (10% off). FileSharing Business, from 3 users, is €18 per user a month monthly or €14.40 yearly. Our dollar reading of the old plans on 4 August 2026 gave Professional $33.99, Business $24 and Business Pro $30 per user per month; we have not re-read dollar prices since the increase. Storage runs 4 TB on Professional, from 6 TB on Business and from 15 TB on Business Pro, with maximum file sizes of 10, 15 and 20 GB. Every plan carries a 14-day trial with no feature limits, but Tresorit requires payment details up front to start it. Enterprise is quote-only.
